name: Taguchi Shougo
source:
Likes: Tuna sandwiches, soda
Dislikes: Roaches, fat on meats
Hobbies: Wearing breakdancing apparels, touring camera shops

A cameraman and a victim trapped in Heavenly Host. He and [url=/c11264]Kibiki[/url] performed the Sachiko Ever After ritual, sending both to the haunted school.

He's devoted to working for Kibiki and also is easily freaked out. Aside from being a cameraman, Shougo is friendly and means well, but he is somewhat clumsy and has the tendency of becoming talkative, hence he is usually the target of [url=/c6509]Naho[/url]'s teasing.

[Edited from the [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Shougo_Taguchi]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
